o.text: By surface analysis, göz (“eye”) + lə. Cognate with Turkish gözlemek (“to observe”) and Turkmen gözlemek (“to search”).
From Proto-Turkic *tabɨĺgan (“hare”). Cognate with Turkish tavşan.
Borrowed from Arabic إِرْثًا (ʔirṯan). By surface analysis, irs + -ən.
